verdict.rationale: Superset's docs say each workspace's Changes tab shows exactly what its agent did. From that built-in diff viewer the developer stages, commits, pushes and clicks Create PR, so the PR exists only after the human reviews and acts. Diff lines can also be selected and sent back to an agent as feedback. Missing for 10: no explicit approval-gate mechanism beyond manual PR creation, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the diff-review-to-PR flow.
